## The Course, in Three Numbers

- **70%** — the NBRC community partner project
- **15%** — homework (5 assignments, 3% each)
- **15%** — participation & attendance

Full breakdown: [syllabus.qmd](../syllabus.html)

## Attendance & Participation

- Attendance tracked starting **Week 2**
- One free absence, no questions asked
- After that: it costs you — heads-up in advance if you know you'll miss one
- This is a lab-heavy course — you learn R by writing R

## AI Tools: Encouraged, With a Catch

- Use AI to help with coding — that's expected, not frowned on
- But: some evaluation is **oral and visual** — presentations, code
  walkthroughs, design critique
- You need to be able to explain and defend your own work
- Over-reliance shows up fast in those moments

## What *Is* Data?

- A spreadsheet is not the same thing as a dataset
- A dataset is not the same thing as a data product
- Discussion: where's the line, and why does it matter for this course?

## What Is Data Science?

The R4DS "whole game":

**import → tidy → transform ⇄ visualize ⇄ model → communicate**

- We'll touch every stage of this loop this semester
- Most of the course lives in transform/visualize — the NBRC project
  forces you through the whole thing

## The Tools

- **R** — the language
- **Posit Cloud** — where we all code, no local install needed
- **Quarto** — how we turn code into reports, slides, and sites
  (this website is built with it)

No live coding today — that starts next week.
